question.text: Investment channels for Indian HNIs include:

answer.text: Direct equity, MFs, PMS, AIFs, structured products, fixed income

explanation.text: The Logic: Full channel set: cash, FD, MF, PMS (Rs. 50 lakh+), AIF (Rs. 1 crore+), direct equity, bonds, REITs, AltCap. The Trap: Single-channel thinking misses diversification. Cross-Exam Context: X-A, XIX-A/B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Match channel to client size, sophistication, objectives — diversify across channels.
